title: Tàu ma
about: Round x5 of the dark ambient style (khong-gian), as the user asked ("hãy sáng tác thêm cho tôi nhiều bài nữa"): a ghost ship drifting in fog: low strings swaying, wind, a slow heartbeat like timbers, a bell tolling from it now and then. B flat minor at 50 bpm. An original piece.
